# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_block (Resource)

A block of phone numbers in a porting order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activation_ranges` (Attributes List) Specifies the activation ranges for this porting phone number block. The activation range must be within the phone number range and should not overlap with other activation ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activation_ranges))
- `phone_number_range` (Attributes) Specifies the phone number range for this porting phone number block. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_range))
- `porting_order_id` (String) The porting order id.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) Specifies the country code for this porting phone number block. It is a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies this porting phone number block.
- `phone_number_type` (String) Specifies the phone number type for this porting phone number block.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--activation_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activation_ranges`

Required:

- `end_at` (String) Specifies the end of the activation range. It must be no more than the end of the phone number range.
- `start_at` (String) Specifies the start of the activation range. Must be greater or equal the start of the phone number range.


<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_range`

Required:

- `end_at` (String) Specifies the end of the phone number range for this porting phone number block.
- `start_at` (String) Specifies the start of the phone number range for this porting phone number block.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_block.example <porting_order_id>/<id>
```
